items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: there was a prominent attorney in this town who, who always had Papa Celestan play for his two or three big parties

ctx.x: Treated me. Uh, because, there, there was, there was a, there was a perception among some people in New Orleans

that my studio was the quote, nigger studio. Mm-hmm. In spite of the fact they did a lot of white guys. Damn, damn. People, people get bugged by it, you know. Yeah. And, I, I had a, there's a, but he's dead now. Dead now. But, but there was a prominent attorney in this town who, who always had Papa Celestan play for his two or three big parties and things like that. He was the worst racist bastard you ever saw. You know. You know. And, and, and, and, and we had an argument.
And I said, you know, I don't understand.
